THE PURPOSE OF THIS MODIFICATION IS TO ENHANCE HEAD IMPACT CRASH PROTECTION FOR FRONT SEAT OCCUPANTS.

title: redundant POLARIS INDUSTRIES, INC.: POLARIS/VICTORY/FUEL PUMP (1,786 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES, THE OUTLET PORT OF THE FUEL PUMP MAY DISLODGE FROM THE PRESSURE REGULATOR HOUSING, REDUCING FUEL PRESSURE AT THE FUEL RAIL.

title: Newmar Corporation: NEWMAR/BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR (1,227 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOME CHASSIS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC AND ELECTRIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."  THE BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR MAY NOT FUNCTION AS REQUIRED BY STANDARD.

title: COUNTRY COACH INC: COUNTRY COACH/ITR/HURRICANE HOT WATER HEATER (485 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORHOMES EQUIPPED WITH INTERNATIONAL THERMAL RESEARCH (ITR)HURRICANE HOT WATER HEATERS, THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL BOARD MAY ADVERSELY AFFECT SAFETY FEATURES IN SOME OF THE SYSTEMS PROTECTING AGAINST OVERHEATING AND POTENTIAL FIRE SITUATION.

title: Aston Martin The Americas: ASTON MARTIN/POWER STEERING HOSE (1,145 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES,THE POWER ASSISTED STEERING HIGH PRESSURE FLEXIBLE HOSE MAY CONTACT THE LEFT HAND EXHAUST MANIFOLD.  IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE HOSE MAY SCORCH THROUGH RESULTING IN A PROGRESSIVE LOSS OF HYDRAULIC FLUID AND POWER ASSISTANCE.

title: Jayco, Inc.: JAYCO/BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR (73 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOME CHASSIS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC AND ELECTRIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."  THE BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR MAY NOT FUNCTION AS REQUIRED BY STANDARD.

title: UNIVERSAL SPECIALTY VEHICLES, INC.: UNIVERSAL SPECIALTY/BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR (26 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOME CHASSIS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC AND ELECTRIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."  THE BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR MAY NOT FUNCTION AS REQUIRED BY STANDARD.

title: IC CORPORATION: IC/AMTRAN/FMVSS 217/FLIP SEAT REINFORCEMENT (159 affected)
summary: CERTAIN SCHOOL BUSES EQUIPPED WITH FLIP SEATS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 217, "BUS EMERGENCY EXITS AND WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."  SEATS WITH SEAT BELTS WERE BOLTED TO THE FLOOR WITHOUT THE USE OF REQUIRED REINFORCEMENTS UNDER THE FLOOR.

title: Daimler Commercial Buses NA: ORION/FMVSS 217/WINDOW HANDLE (4,191 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 217, "BUS EMERGENCY EXITS AND WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."  THE HANDLE PULL FORCE EXCEEDS THE 89N FORCE TO RELEASE THE EMERGENCY WINDOW.  ADDITIONAL FORCE IS REQUIRED TO RELEASE THE WINDOW.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: MERCEDES-BENZ/POWER STEERING HOSE CLAMP (211,000 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE HOSE CLAMP USED TO SECURE THE POWER STEERING FLUID COOLING HOSE TO THE POWER STEERING FLUID COOLER MAY NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT CLAMPING FORCE FOR THIS CONNECTION.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/ALTERNATOR SUPPORT BRACKETS (4,302 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH CUMMINS ISB 6 CYLINDER ENGINES, THE LOWER ALTERNATOR SUPPORT BRACE OR MOUNTING HARDWARE CAN LOOSEN OR BREAK WHICH WILL ALLOW THE ALTERNATOR TO DROP ONTO THE ENGINE.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/SEAT BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLY (312,715 affected)
summary: CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH A DRIVER'S SEAT BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLY THAT CONTAINS AN ENERGY-ABSORBING LOOP.  SUSTAINED LOADS OF SUFFICIENT MAGNITUDE AND DURATION ON THE BELT IN SEVERE CRASHES COULD FULLY DEPLOY THE BUCKLE ENERGY-ABSORBING LOOP, INTRODUCING A TOTAL OF 10 ADDITIONAL INCHES OF WEBBING INTO THE SEAT BELT SYSTEM.  THE FREE FALLING LATCH PLATE USED IN THIS SYSTEM MAY ALLOW WEBBING TO DYNAMICALLY DISTRIBUTE BETWEEN THE LAP AND SHOULDER BELT AS THE DRIVER'S POSITION CHANGES DURING A MULTIPLE ROLLOVER EVENT.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: NISSAN/TRANSMISSION SELECTOR SHAFT NUT (128 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES, THE NUT THAT ATTACHES THE TRANSMISSION GEAR SELECTOR SHAFT TO THE CONTROL VALVE LEVER IN THE TRANSMISSION MAY NOT BE ADEQUATELY TIGHTENED.  THIS COULD RESULT IN THE TRANSMISSION NOT ACTUALLY BEING IN THE GEAR INDICATED BY THE GEAR SELECTOR LEVER.  IN ADDITION, THE TRANSMISSION POSITION DISPLAY IN THE INSTRUMENT PANEL MAY NOT BE ON OR MAY BE INCORRECT.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: BMW/ENGINE IDLE SPEED/DME IDLE CONTROL (1,056 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER AND SPORT WAGON VEHICLES WITH AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSIONS,  WITH THE ENGINE RUNNING, AND THE VEHICLE AT REST, AN INCREASE OF ENGINE IDLE SPEED (UP TO 1,300 RPM) MAY OCCUR.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: PACCAR/KENWORTH/AIR RESERVOIR (45 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH MERITOR P 18X7 BRAKES WITH 36" BRAKE CHAMBERS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD (FMVSS) NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."  THESE TRUCKS WERE MANUFACTURED WITH A COMBINED AIR RESERVOIR VOLUME LESS THAN 12 TIMES THE COMBINED VOLUME OF ALL SERVICE BRAKE CHAMBERS.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/ITR/HURRICANE HOT WATER HEATER (21 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES EQUIPPED WITH INTERNATIONAL THERMAL RESEARCH (ITR)HURRICANE HOT WATER HEATERS, THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL BOARD MAY ADVERSELY AFFECT SAFETY FEATURES IN SOME OF THE SYSTEMS PROTECTING AGAINST OVERHEATING AND POTENTIAL FIRE SITUATION.

title: CPSC, Atico International USA Inc. Announce Recall of Hot Pots
summary: The bottom of the hot pot can separate from the top, which could pose a serious burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 37,000.

title: CPSC, Makita U.S.A. Announce Recall to Repair Electric Sanders
summary: The pads on the sanders can break apart during use and strike the operator, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 350,000.

title: CPSC, IBM Announce Recall to Repair Computer Monitors
summary: The monitor's circuit board can overheat and smoke, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 56,000.

title: CPSC, Murray Inc. Announce Recall of Riding Lawn Tractors
summary: The fuel tank can crack and leak fuel, posing a burn and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 270,000.

title: CPSC, Raymond Oak Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Chests
summary: The toy chest's lid support hinges can fail, allowing the lid to fall onto a child's head, neck, fingers or hands. In addition, spaces at the end of the hinge on the lid can cause pinch, crush or laceration injuries to children's fingers. Units: About 200.

title: CPSC, Comarco Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Detachable Plugs On Power Adapters
summary: The plug can break open and expose live wires, posing an electrocution or electric shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 125,000.

title: CPSC, S. Rothschild & Co. Announce Recall to Repair Girls' Hooded Winter Jackets
summary: The rubber petal and metal snap can break off of the jacket, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 37,000.

title: CPSC, MOSA Sports Announce Recall of Bicycle Helmets
summary: These helmets fail impact testing required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act. Riders wearing these helmets are not adequately protected from falls, and could suffer head injuries. Units: About 1,250.

title: CPSC, Lands' End, Inc., Announce Recall of Little Kids' Parkas
summary: The zipper box may detach, allowing the zipper slide to detach. The small parts, if detached, could pose a risk of choking. Units: Approximately 6,000.

title: CPSC, Trudeau Corp. Announce Recall of Fondue Sets
summary: The plastic handles that are attached to the fondue pots can melt and crack during heating on a range top, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 45,200.

title: CPSC, Blue Star Candles, L.P. Announce Recall of Christmas Candles
summary: The 6-ounce candles can have the wrong size wick, causing the flame to burn irregularly, posing a fire or burn hazard. Units: About 18,000.

title: CPSC, Fire-Lite Alarms Announce Recall of Power Supply for Alarm Systems
summary: Fire-Lite models FCPS-24FS6 and FCPS-24FS8, and Notifier models FCPS-24S6 and FCPS-24S8 can have incomplete solder connections. The Notifier model ACPS-2406 can have an improper circuit response with low input voltage. Both of these conditions may result in a building alarm system not functioning pr

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A. Announce Recall of Small Engines
summary: Vibration during operation can result in abrasion wear to the fuel tube, leading to a fuel leak. If the fuel leak comes in contact with a spark or flame, it can cause a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 45.

title: CPSC, Hitachi Koki U.S.A., Ltd. Announce Recall to Repair Circular Saws
summary: The lower blade guards on these saws can stick in the open position, exposing the blade and posing a serious laceration hazard. Units: About 14,300.

title: CPSC, Maytag Corp. Announce Recall to Repair Gas Ranges
summary: The range can experience a delayed ignition flashback fire in the upper oven, which poses a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 23,000.

title: CPSC, OWT Industries Inc. and Sears Announce Recall of Electric Routers Used in Woodworking
summary: The on-off switch on the routers could stick in the "on" position, posing a risk of serious lacerations to the operator and bystanders. Units: About 5,200.

title: CPSC, The Toro Company Announce Recall of Snowthrowers
summary: The plastic fuel tank can crack and leak gasoline, posing a risk of fire and injury. Units: About 3,400.

title: New law: Do-Not-Call Implementation Act (Public Law 108-10)
summary: H.R. 395 of the 108th Congress became Public Law 108-10 on 2003-03-11.

title: New law: Recognizing the 92d birthday of Ronald Reagan. (Public Law 108-9)
summary: H.J.Res. 19 of the 108th Congress became Public Law 108-9 on 2003-03-06.
